title: Expression and Purification of mCherry-tagged FYVE domain
author: Elisabeth Holzer
materials: Analyze elution fractions via SDS-PAGE and Coomassie staining.

steps.title: Inoculate starter culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate E. coli Rosetta™ (DE3) pLysS cells containing the plasmid into 2× TY medium and incubate with shaking at 37 °C.

steps.title: Grow to mid‑log and cool
steps.instruction: Monitor OD₆₀₀; when it reaches ~0.4, reduce the incubation temperature to 18 °C.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Add IPTG to a final concentration of 100 µM to induce expression.

steps.title: Post‑induction incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the culture at 18 °C for 16 hours with shaking.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 4000 × g for 20 minutes at 4 °C to pellet the cells.

steps.title: Wash and freeze pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet once with ice‑cold 1× PBS (optional), then flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C until purification.

steps.title: Resuspend in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the frozen cell pellets in ice‑cold lysis buffer.

steps.title: Lyse cells by sonication
steps.instruction: Sonicate on ice with two bursts of 30 seconds each at 60 % amplitude.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 20 000 rpm for 45 minutes at 4 °C using a Hitachi Himac CR22N centrifuge (R20A2 rotor).

steps.title: Filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Pass the clarified supernatant through a 0.45 µm filter.

steps.title: Affinity chromatography on HisTrap
steps.instruction: Perform Ni‑NTA purification using a pre‑equilibrated 5 mL HisTrap HP column (Cytiva).

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate the column sequentially with water and then Buffer A.
Load the filtered lysate onto the column.
Wash the column with three column volumes of Buffer A.
Elute bound protein with a stepwise imidazole gradient (30, 75, 100, 150, 225, 300 mM) by increasing the proportion of Buffer B.

steps.title: Concentrate pooled fractions
steps.instruction: Pool the protein‑containing elution fractions and concentrate them using a 10 kDa cut‑off Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter.

steps.title: Size‑exclusion chromatography
steps.instruction: Further purify the concentrated sample by SEC on a Superdex 200 Increase 10/300 GL column equilibrated in SEC buffer.

steps.title: Final storage preparation
steps.instruction: Pool the SEC fractions containing the target protein, concentrate if needed, aliquot, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.
